Streamline your Liferay experience with our groundbreaking AWS EKS Infrastructure Provisioning Plugin. Seamlessly integrated with Liferay, this innovative solution revolutionizes the way you manage your infrastructure, saving you time, resources, and headaches.

With just a few clicks, our plugin empowers you to effortlessly set up a robust AWS EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service) infrastructure tailored specifically for your Liferay instance. No more manual configuration or complex setup processes—our plugin automates the entire deployment process, ensuring a hassle-free experience from start to finish.

Harnessing the power of AWS EKS, our plugin provisions a highly scalable and resilient infrastructure, complete with a state-of-the-art web server, a high-performance database, and a blazing-fast Elasticsearch cluster. Whether you're launching a new Liferay instance or scaling an existing one, our plugin dynamically adapts to your needs, ensuring optimal performance and reliability at all times.

Key Features:

  • Automated Deployment: Say goodbye to tedious manual setup processes. Our plugin automates the provisioning of your AWS EKS infrastructure, saving you valuable time and effort.
     
  • Scalability: Built on AWS EKS, our solution scales seamlessly to accommodate your growing user base and evolving business needs. Whether you're serving hundreds or millions of users, our infrastructure can handle the load with ease.
     
  • Reliability: Rest easy knowing that your Liferay instance is backed by a robust and resilient infrastructure. With redundant components and built-in failover mechanisms, downtime is a thing of the past.
     
  • Performance: Experience lightning-fast performance thanks to our optimized infrastructure setup. From rapid content delivery to near-instantaneous search results, your users will love the speed and responsiveness of your Liferay instance.
     
  • Security: Leverage AWS's industry-leading security features to protect your data and ensure compliance with regulations. With encrypted communication, fine-grained access controls, and regular security updates, your infrastructure is locked down tight.
     
  • Cost Efficiency: Optimize your infrastructure costs with our plugin's intelligent resource management capabilities. Pay only for what you use, and eliminate wasteful spending on idle resources.
     

Unlock the full potential of Liferay with our AWS EKS Infrastructure Provisioning Plugin. Streamline your operations, enhance your performance, and elevate your user experience—all with just a few clicks. Try it today and see the difference for yourself.

name.en_US: AWS EKS Infrastructure Provisioning Plugin for Liferay

description.en_US:
Bridge Your Portal Data and Marketing Power

The HubSpot Connector for Liferay is a powerful integration tool designed to eliminate data silos. It creates a seamless, automated bridge between your Liferay DXP portal and the HubSpot CRM, ensuring your sales and marketing teams always have the most up-to-date information at their fingertips.

Stop wasting time with manual data exports. By connecting Liferay Objects directly to HubSpot, you can ensure that every new contact, company, or lead captured in your portal is instantly synced and ready for your next automated campaign.

Key Features

  • Automatic Lead Generation Forget manual entry. When a record is added to a specific Liferay Object—whether through a registration form, a lead magnet, or a customer portal—the connector automatically creates the corresponding record in HubSpot.

  • Smart Mapping Engine Technical complexity is handled for you. The connector features a smart mapping layer that manages naming conventions and field normalization between both platforms, ensuring data integrity without requiring custom code.

  • Real-Time Synchronization Your marketing team shouldn't have to wait for "overnight batches." The bridge ensures that data flows to your CRM the moment it is captured in Liferay, enabling immediate follow-up and faster conversion.

  • Seamless Installation Built to live natively within your environment, the application is ready to configure immediately after installation from the Liferay Marketplace.

Surekha Technologies is a veteran, Certified Liferay Partner with a proven track record of delivering innovative, enterprise-grade solutions for global clients across the USA, Europe, the Middle East, and the APAC region.


As a specialized Liferay agency, we combine deep technical and functional expertise to empower businesses through AI-supported development, seamless migrations to Liferay, and upgrades to the latest Liferay versions.


From architecting high-performance environments to ensuring quality through automated QA and team alignment, we provide end-to-end consulting to maximize the value of your Liferay investment.

Enrollment Workflow

Learning Dashboard

Personalized dashboard to track courses and Learning progress.

Administration & Course Management

"},"type":"text-block"},{"content":{"title":"Key Features of Liferay DXP E-Learning Solution by Surekha Technologies","description":"

Liferay DXP Aligned Architecture

Utilized Liferay's built-in features Solution built around using Objects, Workflows, Fragments, Collection Display, and Display Page Templates to minimize deep customization and accelerate development.

Object Modeling

Used Liferay Objects to manage core entities including Course, Topic, Quiz, Enrollment - with relationships and Headless REST APIs auto-generated out of the box.

Interactive Components

Implemented dynamic and interactive UI components such as Course Detail, Enrollment Form, Quiz, Progress Tracker, and Certificate Viewer using React Client Extensions embedded as Custom Elements within Liferay Content Pages.

Enrollment Automation

Automated Liferay user account creation and credentials email delivery on enrollment approval using a Groovy script, eliminating manual admin intervention.

Course Builder

Admin can create and manage courses including topics and quizzes through a dedicated React-based Course Builder interface.

Progress Monitoring

Admin can monitor enrolled users per course, track individual progress percentages, and download completion certificates directly from the enrollment management interface.

Auto Completion

Topics are automatically marked as completed when the user navigates to the next topic, removing the need for manual checkbox interaction.

Resume Learning

Course consumption supports resume functionality, allowing users to continue from the exact topic where they previously left off.

Quiz Management

Supports course-level quizzes and exams with configurable assessment flows for evaluating learner progress and understanding.

Certificate Assignment

Automatically assigns and generates completion certificates for users upon successful course completion.

"},"type":"text-block"}]

Powered by the robust Liferay Content Management and Low-Code/No-Code Framework, this solution allows enabling a scalable learning experience for their internal and external users, with full compatibility across the latest Liferay versions.﻿

As an active ecosystem contributor, we have published over 20+ high-performance applications on the official Liferay Marketplace to handle complex organizational and functional demands.

We focus entirely on delivering a specialized core suite of Liferay development services, custom DXP solutions architecture, and enterprise-grade platform upgrade & migration management.

1. Centralized Asset Repository

Store, organize, and manage enterprise documents and digital assets securely within a centralized Liferay DXP environment.

2. Automated PII Detection

Identify sensitive personal information across documents automatically to improve data security and reduce compliance risks.

3. Aadhaar Data Masking

Detect and mask Aadhaar information within documents to protect sensitive data and support privacy compliance requirements.

4. Smart Document Classification

Automatically classify documents into masked, non-masked, and exception categories to simplify validation and governance processes.

5. Advanced File Preview

Preview ZIP, DOCX, XLSX, XLS, and EML files directly within Liferay DXP without downloading or extracting documents.

6. Automated Document Workflows

Streamline document review, validation, masking, and approval processes through automated workflows and reduced manual effort.

7. Compliance & Governance Controls

Strengthen document security with controlled access, audit visibility, and governance policies for managing sensitive enterprise information.

"},"type":"text-block"}]
